Bachelor of Engineering (Industrial Engineering)

1st & 2nd Semester

1st SEMESTER

Common to Aerospace, Biomedical, Chemical, Civil, Computer, Electrical, Industrial and Mechanical Engineering Programs

REQUIRED:
Introduction to Engineering
* Writing Skills
General Chemistry
Calculus I
Linear Algebra
Physics: Mechanics

LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from Table A .

* This course is graded on a pass/fail basis.

2nd SEMESTER

Common to Industrial and Mechanical Engineering Programs

REQUIRED:
Digital Computation and Programming
Principles of Engineering Economics
Engineering Graphical Communication
Calculus II
Materials Science Fundamentals
Physics: Waves and Fields

3rd & 4th Semester

Common to Industrial and Mechanical Engineering Programs.

3rd SEMESTER
REQUIRED:
Communication in the Engineering Professions
Statics and Mechanics of Materials
Introduction to Engineering Design
Differential Equations
Physics: Light and Modern Physics

NOTE: All required courses in 1st and 2nd semester are prerequisites to all required courses in 3rd semester.
4th SEMESTER

REQUIRED:
Electric Circuits
Basic Thermodynamics
Dynamics
Manufacturing Fundamentals
Statistics

LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from Table A .

NOTE: All required courses in 1st and 2nd semester are prerequisites to all required courses in 4th semester.

5th & 6th Semester

5th SEMESTER

REQUIRED:
Work Measurement, Analysis and Design
Algorithms and Web-based Systems
Operations Research I
Experimental Design and Quality Assurance
Fluid Mechanics I
Numerical Analysis

NOTE: All required courses in 1st and 2nd semester are prerequisites to all required courses in 5th semester.

6th SEMESTER

REQUIRED:
Introduction to Management
Facilities Design
Systems Modeling and Simulation
Operations Research II
Industrial Ergonomics
Industrial Psychology

NOTE: All required courses in 1st and 2nd semester are prerequisites to all required courses in 6th semester.

NOTE: Students who have a CLEAR Academic Standing after the 6th semester may opt to enroll in the Industrial Internship Program (IIP). Eligible students should select WKT 88A/B during the Course Intention process.

7th & 8th Semester

7th SEMESTER

REQUIRED:
Industrial Systems Design
Information Systems
Production and Inventory Systems

REQUIRED GROUP 1: One course from the following:
Project Management
* Accounting
Flexible Manufacturing Systems

LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from the following:
Science Fiction
Technology and the Contemporary Environment
Scientific Technology and Modern Society
Religion, Science and Philosophy
Power, Change and Technology

* Recommended for students planning to enter an MBA program.

NOTE: All required courses in 1st through 4th semester are prerequisites to all required courses in 7th semester.
8th SEMESTER

REQUIRED:
Law and Ethics in Engineering Practice
Industrial Systems Design

REQUIRED GROUP 1: Two courses from the following:
Service Operations Management
* Marketing
Reliability and Decision Analysis
* Financial Engineering

LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from Table B .

* Recommended for students planning to enter an MBA program.

NOTE: All required courses in 1st through 4th semester are prerequisites to all required courses in 8th semester.
